name: US Treasury Fiscal Data
summary: US federal finance datasets from the Treasury's keyless Fiscal Data API: public debt, average interest rates on Treasury securities, Treasury reporting exchange rates, Daily and Monthly Treasury Statements.
notes: Keyless. Every dataset takes the same fields, filter, sort, format and page[number]/page[size] parameters.
Sort by -record_date and filter on record_date to get the latest rows; the default order is the first column ascending, which is usually the oldest date.
Pages hold 100 records by default; meta carries total-count and total-pages, and links the next page.
Every field comes back as a string, nulls as the string "null"; meta.dataTypes gives each field's type and meta.labels its readable name.
Each dataset has its own version prefix (v1 or v2) in the path; the docs list all datasets.

endpoints.name: Get total public debt outstanding
endpoints.summary: Total public debt outstanding by record date.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names; all when unset. Leaving fields out can aggregate (sum) the rest.

filter.description: field:operator:value, comma-separated; operators lt, lte, gt, gte, eq, in (list in parentheses); dates YYYY-MM-DD.

sort.description: Comma-separated fields; prefix '-' for descending. Default: first column ascending.
